name: An elemental Primordial Blast button is saved as Primordial Blast (#5469)
contract: An Elemental Mastery transform aura (Ignis 713003, Lithos 717070, Hydros 718040, Stratus 721085) runs aura_ascension_runemaster_primordial_alteration::Transform (AscensionRunemasterElementalTalents.cpp:182), which learns the matching elemental blast (Ignis: 712668) as a temporary spell (learnSpell(alteration->Blast, true), line 195) and replaces every known Primordial Blast rank (chain 800732) with it through SetTemporarySpellReplacement (line 197). A temporary spell is never written to character_spell, and Player::_LoadActions runs before the transform is applied again, so a saved elemental blast button would be refused and deleted at login. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the spell id _SaveActions writes: a button holding the Ignis blast must be saved as Primordial Blast, and a button holding Primordial Blast itself is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Ignis replaces Primordial Blast with its elemental version
The bar holds the Ignis blast
The Ignis blast button is saved as Primordial Blast
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
